title: 埃博拉检测率低：确诊者一半死亡，肯尼亚输入病例会否扩大？
speaker: David Miliband

segments.en: You've characterized this as new world disorder. And I want to ask you about Ebola as a representative thing of that, and as you say, it has been spreading.
segments.zh: 您将这种情况称为“新世界失序”。我想问您埃博拉作为一个代表性事例，正如您所说，它一直在传播。

segments.en: We've seen a case now in Kenya. And I wonder if you look at the public health apparatus globally.
segments.zh: 我们现在在肯尼亚看到一例病例。我想知道您如何看待全球公共卫生体系。

segments.en: How handicapped is it in light of the fact that all this funding has been cut?
segments.zh: 鉴于所有这些资金都被削减，它受到了多大的削弱？

segments.en: I have lived through other Ebola outbreaks where I feel like it was, if not front of mind for a lot of people,
segments.zh: 我经历过其他埃博拉疫情，我觉得那时即使不是很多人最关心的，

segments.en: more often on the front pages of newspapers than it is now. How do you see it ending?
segments.zh: 也比现在更常出现在报纸头版。您认为它会如何结束？

segments.en: Well, it will end with large numbers of casualties.
segments.zh: 嗯，它将伴随着大量伤亡而结束。

segments.en: At the moment, the rate of detection is quite low,
but among those who are detected as having Ebola, half of them are dying.
segments.zh: 但在被检测出感染埃博拉的人中，一半正在死亡。
